data.name: Unvoided
data.detailed_description:
Build Your Spaceship

Mine asteroids and refine raw resources to build your own spaceship from the ground up. Design every section of your vessel, from industrial machinery to propulsion systems, while balancing mass, thrust, and torque to shape how your ship flies and handles in space.

Engineer a Living Spacecraft

Your spaceship is more than a vehicle, it's an ever evolving center of operation. Expand it into a self-sustaining mobile factory by automating production chains, processing resources, and powering increasingly complex systems. Every new module changes the capabilities, behavior, and scale of your spacecraft.

Explore the Void

Venture into a harsh planetless universe filled with asteroid fields, abandoned structures, and remnants of ancient civilizations. Travel alone or coordinate with a crew as you navigate the dangers of deep space and uncover what remains of those who came before.

Survive the Harshness of Space

Space is unforgiving. Manage your ship carefully as you face resource shortages, hazardous environments, and hostile encounters. Engage in spaceship battles, adapt your designs, and keep your vessel operational no matter what the void throws at you.
